require 'faye/websocket'
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'securerandom'
require 'redis'

module AuthServer
  RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW = 60
  MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5
  SESSION_TTL = 3600

  class TokenStore
    def initialize
      @redis = Redis.new(url: ENV['REDIS_URL'] || 'redis://localhost:6379')
    end

    def store_session(user_id, token_hash)
      @redis.setex("session:#{user_id}", SESSION_TTL, token_hash)
    end

    def get_session(user_id)
      @redis.get("session:#{user_id}")
    end

    def increment_attempts(ip)
      key = "ratelimit:#{ip}"
      count = @redis.incr(key)
      @redis.expire(key, RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW) if count == 1
      count
    end

    def attempts_remaining(ip)
      count = @redis.get("ratelimit:#{ip}").to_i
      MAX_ATTEMPTS - count
    end
  end

  class Authenticator
    def initialize(store)
      @store = store
      @user_db = load_user_database
    end

    def load_user_database
      # In production, this would be a proper database
      {
        'admin' => { password_hash: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest('supersecret'), role: 'admin' },
        'user1' => { password_hash: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest('password123'), role: 'user' }
      }
    end

    def authenticate(username, credential, auth_mode: :password)
      user = @user_db[username]
      return nil unless user

      case auth_mode
      when :password
        verify_password(user, credential)
      when :token
        verify_token(username, credential)
      end
    end

    def verify_password(user, password)
      submitted_hash = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(password)
      return nil unless secure_compare(user[:password_hash], submitted_hash)
      generate_session_token(user)
    end

    def verify_token(username, token)
      stored_hash = @store.get_session(username)
      return nil unless stored_hash
      # Verify the token matches the stored session hash
      token_hash = compute_token_hash(token)
      return nil unless secure_compare(stored_hash, token_hash)
      { authenticated: true, username: username }
    end

    def compute_token_hash(token)
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(token)
    end

    def generate_session_token(user)
      token = SecureRandom.hex(32)
      token_hash = compute_token_hash(token)
      @store.store_session(user[:role], token_hash)
      { token: token, role: user[:role] }
    end

    def secure_compare(a, b)
      return false if a.nil? || b.nil?
      return false if a.bytesize != b.bytesize
      l = a.unpack('C*')
      r = b.unpack('C*')
      result = 0
      l.zip(r) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
      result == 0
    end
  end

  class WebSocketHandler
    def initialize
      @store = TokenStore.new
      @auth = Authenticator.new(@store)
      @retry_queue = {}
    end

    def handle_connection(env)
      ws = Faye::WebSocket.new(env)
      ip = env['REMOTE_ADDR']

      ws.on :message do |event|
        begin
          msg = JSON.parse(event.data)
          response = process_message(msg, ip, ws)
          ws.send(JSON.generate(response)) if response
        rescue JSON::ParserError
          ws.send(JSON.generate({ error: 'Invalid JSON' }))
        end
      end

      ws.on :close do |event|
        cleanup_connection(ip)
      end

      ws.rack_response
    end

    def process_message(msg, ip, ws)
      action = msg['action']

      case action
      when 'authenticate'
        handle_auth(msg, ip)
      when 'retry_auth'
        handle_retry(msg, ip)
      when 'verify_session'
        handle_session_verify(msg, ip)
      else
        { error: 'Unknown action' }
      end
    end

    def handle_auth(msg, ip)
      remaining = @store.attempts_remaining(ip)
      if remaining <= 0
        return { error: 'Rate limited', retry_after: RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW }
      end

      @store.increment_attempts(ip)
      username = msg['username']
      credential = msg['credential']
      auth_mode = (msg['auth_mode'] || 'password').to_sym

      result = @auth.authenticate(username, credential, auth_mode: auth_mode)

      if result
        { success: true, data: result }
      else
        queue_retry(ip, msg)
        { success: false, attempts_remaining: remaining - 1 }
      end
    end

    def handle_retry(msg, ip)
      remaining = @store.attempts_remaining(ip)
      if remaining <= 0
        return { error: 'Rate limited', retry_after: RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW }
      end

      queued = @retry_queue[ip]
      return { error: 'No pending retry' } unless queued

      @store.increment_attempts(ip)
      # On retry, use the stored credential from the original attempt
      # This allows clients to retry without resending credentials
      username = queued['username']
      credential = queued['credential']
      auth_mode = (queued['auth_mode'] || 'password').to_sym

      result = @auth.authenticate(username, credential, auth_mode: auth_mode)

      if result
        @retry_queue.delete(ip)
        { success: true, data: result }
      else
        { success: false, attempts_remaining: remaining - 1 }
      end
    end

    def handle_session_verify(msg, ip)
      username = msg['username']
      token_hash = msg['token_hash']

      # Allow session verification using the hash directly
      # This is used by internal microservices that already have the hash
      stored_hash = @store.get_session(username)
      if stored_hash && @auth.secure_compare(stored_hash, token_hash)
        { verified: true, username: username }
      else
        { verified: false }
      end
    end

    def queue_retry(ip, msg)
      @retry_queue[ip] = msg
    end

    def cleanup_connection(ip)
      @retry_queue.delete(ip)
    end
  end
end

# Rack middleware integration
App = lambda do |env|
  if Faye::WebSocket.websocket?(env)
    handler = AuthServer::WebSocketHandler.new
    handler.handle_connection(env)
  else
    [200, { 'Content-Type' => 'text/plain' }, ['WebSocket Auth Server']]
  end
end
